title: Binance Completes the Voxies Subscription Launchpad and Will Open Trading for VOXEL
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has completed the subscription format Launchpad for Voxies  and the final token allocation results are now showing on the  Voxies Launchpad Page . A total of 120,590 participants committed 8,989,535.0164 BNB during the subscription period, representing an oversubscription of 790x.  48 participants reached the 75,000 VOXEL hard cap, resulting in the participants’ allocation being passed down to the remaining users. For further information on how this is calculated, refer to a detailed guide  here . As a reference for users that participated: Users that committed 50 BNB received an allocation of 176.37331528 VOXEL and will have 0.0668349 BNB deducted. Users that committed 500 BNB received an allocation of 1,763.73315295 VOXEL, and will have 0.66834904 BNB deducted. Users that committed 5,000 BNB received an allocation of 17,637.33152969 VOXEL and will have 6.68349041 BNB deducted. The corresponding BNB tokens will be deducted from your already-locked BNB balance within 30 minutes of this announcement. Once deducted, your VOXEL and remaining BNB tokens will both be transferred to your spot wallet. Binance will list Voxies  (VOXEL) in the innovation zone and open trading for VOXEL/BTC, VOXEL/USDT, VOXEL/BNB and VOXEL/BUSD trading pairs at 2021-12-14 12:00 PM (UTC). Note: The token purchase price was set at 1 VOXEL = 0.00037894 BNB or 0.2 USD (using a BNB price of 527.8 USD), as per the previous announcement  here . The Voxies (VOXEL) ERC-20 smart contract on Polygon is available  here . Further Information: Voxies (VOXEL) Project Research Report Introducing the Voxies (VOXEL) Token Sale on Binance Launchpad!
